dataset.title: Los Angeles public six-minute benchmark 2021
dataset.intended_use: reproducible offline RL benchmark and port-adapter validation
dataset.license: U.S. public domain source data; code MIT

column_treatments.tide_m: NOAA measured with declared short-gap linear interpolation
column_treatments.ambient_c: NOAA measured with declared short-gap linear interpolation
column_treatments.wind_speed_mps: NOAA measured with declared short-gap linear interpolation
column_treatments.throughput_teu: BTS monthly aggregate with deterministic six-minute allocation

NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services

dataset.warning: This is a public benchmark, not terminal telemetry. Site equipment, berth, yard, tariff, carbon, call and control-limit fields require operator-approved replacement before field use.

warnings: 2 timestamp gaps differ from the median cadence

algorithms.name: SAC
algorithms.description: Maximum-entropy off-policy actor-critic for continuous port setpoints.

algorithms.name: PPO
algorithms.description: Clipped on-policy optimization for stable constrained control.

algorithms.name: TD3
algorithms.description: Twin critics and delayed actor updates for continuous dispatch.

algorithms.name: DQN
algorithms.description: Replay-buffer Q-learning on an explicit finite port-control lattice.

algorithms.name: A2C
algorithms.description: Synchronous advantage actor-critic baseline for low-overhead on-policy optimization.

algorithms.name: TQC
algorithms.description: Distributional off-policy actor-critic with truncated quantile critics.
